author: Rick Buda
text: The fact that you get a reading for a while, then it malfunctions means you put it in/on fine... Something is wrong with the sensor.

author: Mark Stewart
text:
Libre sensors are unreliable and inaccurate in my experience.  I bought 6, the last two indicated highs and lows alarming all hours day and night. I'm using the last sensor now which seems OK, still not accurate but more accurate than the last two.
I will be switching to another brand that has better customer support and more reliable asap.
